formats.name: image_pin
formats.notes: BMP/JPEG/PNG/TIFF/WEBP; 20 MB web upload; alt text 500; safe zone px top 270 left 65 right 195 bottom 790. Link (destination) 2048 chars via API.

formats.name: video_pin
formats.notes: MP4/M4V (web), MP4/MOV/M4V (apps), H.264 or H.265; 1:2, 2:3, 3:4, 4:5, 1:1 also accepted; 15-60 s recommended; needs cover image; organic file-size cap not confirmed

formats.notes: 2-5 images (ad spec page and API multiple_image_urls); 20 MB per image per ad spec page; organic UI details not confirmed
